company.oneLiner: Hearthbooks keeps the books of independent bakeries.
company.longDescription: Hearthbooks is bookkeeping software for the owners of independent bakeries with one to three shops. Owners scan their receipts and Hearthbooks files them, reconciles the bank and prepares the VAT return.
painPoints: Receipts pile up in a shoebox
The VAT return takes a weekend
featuresBenefits: Scan a receipt and it is filed

company.oneLiner: Tallyroute plans the delivery routes of food wholesalers.
company.longDescription: Tallyroute plans the daily routes of food wholesalers that deliver to shops and restaurants across Europe with their own vans. Fleet managers plan a day in minutes.
painPoints: Routes planned by hand every evening
featuresBenefits: A day's routes planned in minutes
